page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-72 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 CPU architecture, paired with 576.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, positioning it for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from the efficiency of ARM-based silicon.

The instance does not include local NVMe storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the c4a-highmem-72 does not feature any GPU accelerators, limiting its utility for hardware-accelerated machine learning or graphics rendering. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

Utilizing the arm64 architecture generally offers a high resource density and qualitative cost-efficiency advantage compared to traditional x86 architectures for compatible software stacks. The 72 dedicated vCPUs and 576.0 GB RAM allocation make this instance suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines that do not require local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.
